environment: Ubuntu 26.04 ARM64, Sway 1.11 headless compositor, pixman renderer, one 1280x800 output at scale 1, GTK3, gtk-layer-shell 0.10.0
failure_found_and_fixed_in_probe: Initial input shape alone passed the first map but intercepted input after hide/show. Reapplying the empty input region in the GTK map callback fixed the remap check.
verification: Only CUA/noVNC UI actions; fixture program emits native click, map and unmap observations. Sway get_outputs read-only query confirms 1280x800 geometry.
production_constraint: GTK layer-shell must initialize before realization. The installed Tauri API has no documented pre-realization layer-shell hook. Its hidden renderer realization state has not yet been observed; verify that before choosing the integration path.
scope_limits: This probe is not the shipped LiveBlock renderer. The current application still uses a floating Wayland fallback.
Portal capture, compositor loss, multiple outputs, fractional scale and hardware GPU remain unverified.
next_implementation_check: Observe the actual hidden Tauri renderer realization state on Wayland. Initialize that GTK window only if still unrealized; otherwise own a separate native GTK renderer and editor from creation. Reapply the empty input region on each map.
